REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - NOVEMBER 15, 2017 - CITY HALL -
7:00
P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS:
Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the Community Development Department, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m.
to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1201. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Cerritos Planning Commission after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Community Development Department at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time
each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the meeting will not
exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless
determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate
responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the
agenda, unless otherwise directed. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially
the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, public hearing is opened, and
report of written correspondence and staff report are received. Verbal testimony will occur
in the following order: those in favor of the application/item, those opposed, interested
parties, rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested to state their name and city of
residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the
matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the public
hearing.

Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2017-7, A REQUEST TO AMEND THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE BY ADDING CHAPTER 22.53, AREA DEVELOPMENT PLAN EIGHTEEN (ADP-18), TO ESTABLISH SPECIFIC DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS FOR A PROPOSED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT LOCATED AT 13017 ARTESIA BOULEVARD (APN 7008-004-033).*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT 2017-2, A REQUEST TO AMEND THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN LAND USE MAP BY CHANGING THE LAND USE DESIGNATION OF APPROXIMATELY ±2.53 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 13017 ARTESIA BOULEVARD (APN 7008-004-033), FROM OFFICE PROFESSIONAL COMMERCIAL TO AREA DEVELOPMENT PLAN EIGHTEEN (ADP-18) - SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL.*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE DEVELOPMENT MAP AMENDMENT 2017-3, A REQUEST TO AMEND THE CERRITOS DEVELOPMENT MAP BY CHANGING THE ZONE CLASSIFICATION OF APPROXIMATELY ±2.53 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 13017 ARTESIA BOULEVARD (APN 7008-004-033), FROM COMMERCIAL OFFICE PROFESSIONAL (COP) TO AREA DEVELOPMENT PLAN EIGHTEEN (ADP-18) - SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL.*
*One Mitigated Negative Declaration was prepared in accordance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) for Development Code Amendment 2017-7, General Plan Amendment 2017-2, Development Map Amendment 2017-3, Vesting Tentative Tract Map 75009, Precise Plan 2017-13, and Community Facilities District 2017-1.

B.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF VESTING TENTATIVE TRACT MAP 75009, A PROPOSAL BY MLC HOLDINGS, INC., TO SUBDIVIDE AN EXISTING PARCEL INTO A TRACT COMPRISED OF TWENTY-NINE (29) SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL PARCELS AND COMMON AREA PARCELS FOR LANDSCAPING, OPEN SPACE AMENITIES, INTERIOR PRIVATE STREETS, AND A DECORATIVE GATED ENTRY. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS LOCATED AT 13017 ARTESIA BOULEVARD (APN 7008-004-033).*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 2017-13, A PROPOSAL BY MLC HOLDINGS, INC., TO DEMOLISH FOUR (4) EXISTING TWO-STORY COMMERCIAL OFFICE BUILDINGS AND CONSTRUCT A NEW GATED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT COMPRISED OF TWENTY-NINE (29) TWO-STORY DETACHED RESIDENCES FEATURING ENHANCED ARCHITECTURAL DETAILING IN A VARIETY OF TRADITIONAL ARCHITECTURAL STYLES. THE PROPOSED DEVELOPMENT INCLUDES PARKWAY AND ONSITE LANDSCAPING IMPROVEMENTS, PASSIVE OPEN SPACE AREAS, A DECORATIVE GATED ENTRY, AND RELATED IMPROVEMENTS. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS LOCATED AT 13017 ARTESIA BOULEVARD (APN 7008-004-033).*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt a RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE COMMUNITY FACILITIES DISTRICT 2017-1, A PUBLIC SERVICES COMMUNITY FACILITIES DISTRICT FOR A TWENTY-NINE (29) UNIT SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT LOCATED AT 13017 ARTESIA BOULEVARD (APN 7008-004-033).*
*One Mitigated Negative Declaration was prepared in accordance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) for Development Code Amendment 2017-7, General Plan Amendment 2017-2, Development Map Amendment 2017-3, Vesting Tentative Tract Map 75009, Precise Plan 2017-13, and Community Facilities District 2017-1.
